correctness.rationale: For all odd n and nonnegative iterations, the monomial inverse is certified by BH=I+J, the iterate cancellation by circulant column minima, and the extremal residue by a detailed circular arc overlap proof. Fourier filtering gives pairwise distinct reciprocal Chebyshev roots and nonvanishing amplitudes for each parity, establishing the stated minimal recurrence and dominant asymptotic. The accompanying exact arithmetic script checks 50 odd dimensions and 1584 recurrence instances; tests are corroboration only.
